1. Create account
Your request is sent to the administrator.
2. Receive admin code
The administrator creates and sends your personal access code.
3. Activate & sign in
Enter your code once. Future sign-ins only require your approved account.

Cloud Account

LOCAL MODE
Your approved Planora account is connected to Firebase for secure cloud sync. Access is controlled by the administrator.
Connecting to Firebase…
GitHub Pages setup: after publishing, add your GitHub Pages domain (for example username.github.io) in Firebase Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains. Enable Email/Password and Google providers.

Calendar Connection

Send Planora planner entries to Google Calendar or Apple / iOS Calendar.

Google Calendar

Open Google Calendar with a Planora event already filled in. You can review it before saving.

Apple / iOS Calendar

Export all Planora dated items as an .ics calendar file. Open the file on iPhone, iPad or Mac to add the events.
Important: this version supports one-way add/export from Planora to Google Calendar and Apple Calendar. True automatic two-way synchronization requires Google Calendar OAuth/API permissions and a separate secure integration.

Install on iPhone / iPad

Open Planora in Safari → tap Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. After installation, Planora opens like a standalone app.
